name: vestaloop_update_event
description: Update an existing event by `id`. This REPLACES the event's fields, so pass the complete intended state — title, starts_at and ends_at are always required, not just the fields you're changing. To change one field, first call vestaloop_get_event and resend the other values unchanged. Times are UTC ISO-8601. `scope` is 'personal' or 'shared'. Requires a read/write key (403 otherwise). The change is pushed to the linked Google calendar. Returns the updated event.
